name: City Journey 01 · Blocks, Bridge & Central Park

signs.text: WESTSIDE → Go north through the jam. Read the red/green signals; stopped traffic leaves gaps, not a protected crossing.
DELIVERY BLOCK → Turn right toward the overpass. Roaches patrol both sidewalk lanes.
OVERPASS ↑ Climb the ramp. Cars stay below; rail hoppers jump onto your deck.
PARK ENTRANCE ← Turn left, then north. Watch the quick bush lunge.
CENTRAL PARK → Use the pond openings. Watch a swing or flock finish before crossing its path.
EASTSIDE RETURN ↓ Wider sidewalks ahead. The camera looks into your travel direction.
ICE RINK ↓ Momentum carries you. Release early or hold Shift to brake; give the skating duet room.
HOME STRETCH ↓ Two slower streets. Reach the south gate to unlock Skate Escape.

description: Cross the jammed west streets, climb the skaters' overpass, weave through Central Park, then slide across the rink and take the wider eastside home. Clear this journey to unlock Skate Escape.
